name: design-editorial
title_zh: 杂志版式编辑器，衬线字体排印出纸媒质感
tagline_zh: 把网页排版拉回纸质杂志的优雅：结构化网格、衬线字体、留白呼吸感。适合长文阅读、品牌叙事、作品集，让内容自带高级感。
tagline_en: Bring back print elegance: structured grids, serif type, breathing whitespace. Ideal for long reads, brand.
desc_en: Magazine-inspired editorial layout with refined serif typography, structured grids, and elegant reading experiences.
why_zh: 不止是CSS模板，内置编辑决策机制：自动平衡版面密度、对齐网格、控制字距行距。
why_en: Not just CSS—it applies editorial judgment: auto-balances density, aligns to grid, tunes kerning and leading, like a senior art.
limit_zh: 仅覆盖静态杂志式排版，不支持交互组件、动画或响应式适配；需要手动提供高质量图片与长文本，短内容或碎片化信息会显得空旷。
limit_en: Static editorial layouts only—no interactions, animations, or responsive design. Needs high-res images and long-form text; short snippets will look.
title_en: Magazine-style layout editor with refined serif typography
